actions.name: compromise victim network
actions.description: LockBit 2.0 ransomware compromises victim networks through a variety of techniques, including purchased access, unpatched vulnerabilities, insider access, and zero day exploits.
actions.reproducibility_reason: The target host has no deployable service, so it is left out of deployment; this step is not reproduced until a service or substitute is supplied for that host.

actions.name: use Mimikatz to escalate privileges
actions.description: After compromising a victim network, LockBit 2.0 actors use publicly available tools such as Mimikatz to escalate privileges.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: exfiltrate data using publicly available and custom tools
actions.description: The threat actors then use both publicly available and custom tools to exfiltrate data.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: encrypt data using LockBit malware
actions.description: LockBit 2.0 actors encrypt data using the LockBit malware after exfiltration.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: leave ransom note in each affected directory
actions.description: The actors always leave a ransom note in each affected directory within victim systems, which provides instructions on how to obtain the decryption software and threatens to leak exfiltrated victim data on the LockBit 2.0 leak site.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: automatically encrypt devices across Windows domains using Active Directory group policies
actions.description: In July 2021, LockBit 2.0 released an update which featured the automatic encryption of devices across Windows domains by abusing Active Directory group policies.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires an isolated Windows AD DC/member VM fixture and native health checks; this deployment environment has no VM backend/image configured.

actions.name: advertise for insiders to establish initial access
actions.description: In August 2021, LockBit 2.0 began to advertise for insiders to establish initial access into potential victim networks, promising a portion of the proceeds from a successful attack.
actions.reproducibility_reason: The target host has no deployable service, so it is left out of deployment; this step is not reproduced until a service or substitute is supplied for that host.

actions.name: develop Linux-based malware targeting VMWare ESXi virtual machines
actions.description: LockBit 2.0 developed a Linux-based malware which takes advantage of vulnerabilities within VMWare ESXi virtual machines.
actions.reproducibility_reason: The target host has no deployable service, so it is left out of deployment; this step is not reproduced until a service or substitute is supplied for that host.

actions.name: decode strings and load required modules using bitwise operations
actions.description: LockBit 2.0 is a heavily obfuscated ransomware application leveraging bitwise operations to decode strings and load required modules to evade detection.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: check for administrative privileges and escalate if insufficient
actions.description: Upon launch, LockBit 2.0 determines if the process has administrative privileges and attempts to escalate if privileges are not sufficient.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: check system and user language settings and exit if Eastern European language detected
actions.description: LockBit 2.0 determines the system and user language settings and only targets those not matching a set list of Eastern European languages; if an Eastern European language is detected, the program exits without infection.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: delete log files and shadow copies on disk
actions.description: As infection begins, LockBit 2.0 deletes log files and shadow copies residing on disk.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: enumerate system information
actions.description: LockBit 2.0 enumerates system information including hostname, host configuration, domain information, local drive configuration, remote shares, and mounted external storage devices.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: encrypt data on local and remote devices excluding core system files
actions.description: LockBit 2.0 attempts to encrypt any data saved to any local or remote device but skips files associated with core system functions.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: self-delete from disk and create persistence at startup
actions.description: Once completed, LockBit 2.0 deletes itself from disk and creates persistence at startup.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: exfiltrate files using Stealbit application
actions.description: LockBit affiliates primarily use the Stealbit application obtained from the LockBit panel to exfiltrate specific file types configured by the affiliate to tailor the attack to the victim.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: exfiltrate files using other commercially available tools
actions.description: Some attackers use other commercially available tools such as rclone and MEGAsync to exfiltrate files.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: use publicly available file sharing services for system compromise or exploration
actions.description: LockBit 2.0 actors often use publicly available file sharing services including privatlab.net, anonfiles.com, sendspace.com, fex.net, transfer.sh, and send.exploit.in to aid in system compromise or exploration.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: delete shadow copies using vssadmin
actions.description: LockBit 2.0 deletes shadow copies on disk using the command 'cmd.exe /c vssadmin Delete Shadows /All /Quiet'.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: disable Windows 10 recovery
actions.description: LockBit 2.0 disables Windows 10 recovery using the command 'cmd.exe /c bcdedit /set {default} recoveryenabled No'.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: ignore boot failures
actions.description: LockBit 2.0 sets boot status policy to ignore all failures using the command 'cmd.exe /c bcdedit /set {default} bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures'.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: delete security, system, and application logs
actions.description: LockBit 2.0 deletes security, system, and application logs using commands 'cmd.exe /c wevtutil cl security', 'cmd.exe /c wevtutil cl system', and 'cmd.exe /c wevtutil cl application'.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: wipe and delete itself
actions.description: LockBit 2.0 wipes and deletes itself using the command 'cmd.exe "C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe" /C ping 127.0.0.7 -n 3 >Nul&fsutil file setZeroData offset=0 length=524288 "C:\Users\fred\Desktop\Lsystem-234-bit.exe" & Del /f /q "C:\Users\fred\Desktop\Lsystem-234-bit.exe"'.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

actions.name: delete all shadow copies and disable recovery features
actions.description: LockBit 2.0 deletes all shadow copies on disk and disables recovery features using the combined command 'cmd.exe "C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe" /c vssadmin delete shadows /all /quiet & wmic shadowcopy delete & bcdedit /set {default} bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures & bcdedit /set {default} recoveryenabled no'.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

actions.name: create registry keys for UAC bypass, wallpaper change, persistence, encryption, icon location, and desktop modification
actions.description: LockBit 2.0 creates multiple registry keys for UAC bypass, wallpaper change, persistence, encryption, icon location, and desktop modification.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

actions.name: create LockBit 2.0 files on victim system
actions.description: LockBit 2.0 creates files including LockBit_Ransomware.hta on desktop, an icon file in SysWOW64, and a wallpaper bmp file in AppData Local Temp.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: disable Windows Defender via Group Policy update
actions.description: LockBit 2.0 disables Windows Defender by updating Group Policy settings to disable antispyware, real-time monitoring, sample submission, threat severity default actions, and suppress notifications, then forces Group Policy update via PowerShell.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires an isolated, versioned Windows AD DC/member fixture; OS/AD versions and topology are missing. No version is assumed.

actions.name: send HTTP PUT request with hexadecimal value to command and control server
actions.description: After a host establishes a connection to one of the command and control servers, a HTTP PUT request with hexadecimal value and a length of 32 or 33 characters is sent to the command and control server.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.
